capabilities: Underline text that matches other notes' titles or aliases
Insert wiki-links from approved hover suggestions
Rank candidates with tunable weighted scoring signals
Remember rejected suggestions and learned aliases
Re-rank candidates by meaning with a local embedding model
extras: The author notes "This software was vibe-coded." The optional semantic tier downloads a ~50 MB embedding model once, or can point at a local transformers.js-format model; the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff and can be installed via BRAT.
problem: Manual wiki-linking is tedious and naive auto-linkers produce noise because they match note titles only by exact text.

relations.evidence: Via BRAT: add this repository as a beta plugin, then enable Auto Linker

summary: Underlines text matching other note titles and offers one-click wiki-link insertion, ranked by a multi-signal confidence score.
